newFeatures.title: Excel Add-in v0.4.0
description: The new version `v0.4.0` of the _Excel Add-in_ is available, and it supports the new **Business Glossary**: terms can now be pulled, enriched, and pushed from an Excel worksheet.
Check the [changelog](/docs/15.2.0/products/data_catalog/excel_add_in/changelog) for the full list of changes.

newFeatures.title: Custom Fields
description: Items can now be enriched with **Custom Fields**: typed, validated metadata that extends an Item Type without modifying its native schema — ideal for business or governance attributes that aren't covered out of the box. See the [Custom Fields documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/catalog/basic-concepts/custom-fields) for the full workflow.

newFeatures.title: LLM Description for Item Types
description: Item Type Definitions can now carry an **LLM Description**, a natural-language description written for AI agents and LLMs that explains what the items of the type represent and how to use their fields. See the [Item Types documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/catalog/basic-concepts/item-types#llm-description).

newFeatures.title: Governance templates
description: Rules, scorecards, and campaigns can now be saved as **templates** shared with all the users of the tenant. Templates cannot be edited or deleted, but their parameters can be changed every time they are used. See [Rules](/docs/15.2.0/products/catalog/basic-concepts/evaluation-criteria#templates), [Scorecards](/docs/15.2.0/products/catalog/basic-concepts/scorecards#templates), and [Campaigns](/docs/15.2.0/products/catalog/basic-concepts/campaigns#templates).

improvements.title: User Profile page
description: Every user now has a [Profile page](/docs/15.2.0/products/mia-platform-suite/rbac-management#profile) listing their tenants, groups, and effective roles.

newFeatures.title: AI Gateway & MCP Gateway
description: AI Foundry becomes a governed control plane for models and AI tools: the **AI Gateway** is a single proxy for LLM traffic with cost tracking, caching, guardrails/policies, and observability, while **MCP Federation** unifies multiple MCP servers behind one Foundry-governed endpoint with a federated registry and centralized discovery.

newFeatures.title: Playbook assistant
description: A new assistant helps you create a playbook starting from a template to fill in with your use case. See the [Playbook documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/playbook#playbook-assistant).

newFeatures.title: MCP prompts and resources
description: MCP servers can now expose **prompts** and **resources** to agents, in addition to tools. See the [MCP Server documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/mcp-server#prompts-and-resources).

improvements.title: Mia AI Runtime and app built-in tools
description: Internal tools such as `web_search` are now provided by the **Mia AI Runtime** and must be enabled explicitly on each agent. Built-in tools of Claude Code, VS Code, and JetBrains are also available. See the [Tool documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/ai-foundry/basic-concepts/tool).

improvements.title: Ownership aligned with Catalog RBAC
description: The owner of a resource is now the principal ID used by the Catalog RBAC.

improvements.title: Agent Graph
description: The **Agentic Flow** step of the Playbook Builder has been renamed **Agent Graph**.

improvements.title: Editor productivity
description: Modals and drawers can be confirmed with **⌘/Ctrl+Enter**, and the Agentic Workflow editor autocompletes interpolation fields (`inputs`, `steps`).

improvements.title: Improved yaml schema validation for Helm charts
description: The chart editor of Charts section in Design Area now validates `values.yaml` live against each chart's schema using the official `monaco-yaml` engine — including subchart dependencies from `Chart.yaml` — replacing the previous custom validation logic.

improvements.title: Form-based editing for Infrastructure Resources
description: Infrastructure Resources created from a Marketplace item that defines a JSON schema now keep their **form** after creation: the JSON schema of the selected item version is applied to validate the resource not only when it is first added, but also on every subsequent edit.

You can still switch to the YAML editor for more advanced changes; if the manifest no longer matches the JSON schema of the item version, switching back to the form is disabled. Once a resource is detached from the Marketplace, only the YAML editor is available.
Check the [Infrastructure Resources documentation](/docs/15.2.0/products/console/design-your-projects/custom-resources/custom-resources#update-an-infrastructure-resource) for more details.

improvements.title: Authentication Service v3.14.2
description: The new version `v3.14.2` of the _Authentication Service_ is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.
It also fixes the `/userinfo` response, which again always includes the `groups` field, restoring the pre-3.13.0 contract.
Check the [changelog](/docs/15.2.0/runtime-components/plugins/authentication-service/changelog) for the full list of changes.

improvements.title: Client Credentials v3.5.1
description: The new version `v3.5.1` of the _Client Credentials_ service is available!
This release adds **TLS encryption management** in the Redis Sentinel configuration.

It also adds support for authenticating to **Redis Sentinel** with its own username and password, distinct from the Redis master's credentials, via the `REDIS_SENTINEL_USERNAME` and `REDIS_SENTINEL_PASSWORD` environment variables.
Check the [changelog](/docs/15.2.0/runtime-components/plugins/client-credentials/changelog) for the full list of changes.

bugFixes.title: JWT Token Validator v1.3.0
description: The new version `v1.3.0` of the _JWT Token Validator_ is available!
JWT payload decoding now uses base64url encoding, fixing spurious `unable decoding JWT payload` errors for claim values containing multi-byte UTF-8 characters (e.g. accented letters).
The `/verify` handler now refreshes the JWKS and retries when the cached keys can't verify the token (e.g. after a key rotation), instead of failing immediately.
Check the [changelog](/docs/15.2.0/runtime-components/plugins/jwt-token-validator/changelog) for the full list of changes.
